userPrompt:
This is a site where the user can have access to a designated calculator app for a specific set of statics problems.

The goal is for every customer ID to have a one time access, meaning they can always come back to the site but only click "Calculate" once.

We work with supabase+vercel. Tell me the steps for setting up the project!

UI:

UI should resemble the example pages (examples folder)

This tool is a helper for calculating tasks that are the same as the examples but with other numbers.

For this we need a UI, that closely resemles the examples pages, as people working with the page are very stupid, and we need an idiot proof solution for them to exactly know what to input inside the input fields. 

So what we are doing:

- user gets the live task on the exam, which is virtually the same as one of our example tasks
- user opens our calculator
- scrolls down until they see the task they got on the exam
- input fields are in the place of our variables For example "Az ismert adatok:

a=[Input field] m, b=[Input field] m q1
=[Input field] kN/m, F2=[Input field] kN, α=[Input field] "

They input the variables

After calculation, the results are showed on the same example task as basic text instead of the currently seen input fields from the original example (maybe a little highlight)

For example

"Adja meg az A csukló által kifejtett kényszererőt!

F⃗ A=
[Result1 (1 válaszmező a 1. részhez)]

e⃗ x+
[Result2 (2 válaszmező a 1. részhez)]
"
ect...

For configuring where on the examples we have the necessary inputs and result-input fields, and for naming these and specifying the equations, we need a dev site. from this we save the configs into the JSON.
